description: List security alerts (notifications), newest first, as compact summaries: rule, severity, status, test mode, IPs with AI verdicts, agent status and proposed actions. Open alerts by default; securenow_notifications_get returns one alert in full.

archived.description: true lists archived alerts instead of open ones.

search.description: Optional text search over the alert title, IPs and rule.

severity.description: Optional severity filter: critical, high, medium or low.

status.description: Optional status filter, for example open, pending_review or resolved.

name: securenow_notifications_list
title: List Notifications
